{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows no positive signal (sentiment=0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows strong downward momentum and true outcome is below model.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment=0.00) to avoid underestimating rebounds.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if model is consistently above true outcome over 5+ days, reduce forecast by 10-15% for next period.",
    "If model spikes sharply after a low, reduce forecast by 15-20% to avoid overshoot, especially if sentiment remains flat.",
    "When sentiment history includes a single positive signal (sentiment=0.50), slightly increase forecast to reflect potential upward momentum.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, apply a smoothing filter to reduce volatility — avoid sharp peaks or troughs unless sentiment supports them."
  ]
}
